A Day at Home

Morning light spills across the kitchen table. A pot of tea steams beside an open notebook.

The notebook holds sketches of old bridges. Each drawing has a small note about its arch.

Outside, a neighbour waters the lavender. The scent drifts through the open window.

Later, the telescope is set up on the balcony. Jupiter is bright and steady tonight.

At last the house grows quiet. Only the clock and a distant train can be heard.
